mossback-grotto.name: Mossback Woods
mossback-grotto.description: Forgiving woodland. Fall through the leaves into real branching trees, scramble through forks, and recover on the rolling forest floor. The trunks and branches are solid; foliage is scenery.

amber-arches.name: Razorback Range
amber-arches.description: Treacherous alpine ridges. Sharp summits throw you off balance and steep scree faces send you sliding toward flooded ravines. Find shelter in the foothills or grapple between peaks.

mooncap-garden.name: Moonwell Sinkhole
mooncap-garden.description: A deep flooded sinkhole crossed by a twisting exposed root. Start on the sheltered rims, descend into eroded wall pockets, and risk the broken crossings above the water.
mooncap-garden.terrain: Very dangerous · Exposed roots · Deep water
